entries.land_location_as_stated: Situated on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine
entries.description: A seasonal womyn's guest house and retreat offering three rooms, run by two lesbians on an island in Maine.
entries.raw_text: SEA GNOMES' HOME PO Box 33, Stonington, ME 04681 (207)367-5076. Womyn's Guest House offering 3 rooms at reasonable rates. Seasonal - June thru Sept. Situated on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine. No bars, no TV, no swimming pool (though there is a lake near). Just a quiet retreat in a beautiful place. We are: 2 lesbians.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space because it is a guest house and describes itself as 'Just a quiet retreat'. Land city Stonington and state ME inferred from contact address and description 'Situated on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine'. PO Box is never the land address. Num_residents left blank because 'We are: 2 lesbians' is not accompanied by a statement that women live on the land. Lesbian women coded from directory context and 'We are: 2 lesbians'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the heart of Mid-Coast Maine, where the mountains meet the sea
entries.description: A women's guest house on 18 acres in mid-coast Maine with domestic and farm animals and gardens, offering lodging, home-cooked meals, and partial work exchanges to lesbian and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: LAUREL RIDGE RFD 2 Box 277, Lincolnville, ME 04849 (207)338-1913 (Northport, ME). Laurel Ridge is a guest house for women on 18 beautiful acres of fields and woods in the heart of Mid-Coast Maine, where the mountains meet the sea. Our rates are very reasonable and our guests enjoy comfortable lodging and delicious home-cooked meals. There are domestic and farm animals about the place, as well as vegetable, herb, and flower gardens. Partial work exchange possible. Open year round. We welcome: non-lesbian women. No drugs or alcohol. We have/are: 18 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space because it is a guest house for women. Land address matches rural route mailing address. Recovery/substance-free coded for 'No drugs or alcohol'. Farming/self-sufficiency coded for 'domestic and farm animals about the place, as well as vegetable, herb, and flower gardens'. Non-lesbian women coded because 'We welcome: non-lesbian women'; Lesbian women coded from directory context. Num_residents is blank because no specific number of residents is stated despite 'women living and working on the land'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the Blue Mountains; in a private setting in the State Game Lands, one mile down from the Appalachian Trail
entries.description: A vacation cabin on two acres in the Blue Mountains accommodating seven persons for weekly, weekend, or daily rentals, welcoming new residents, children of all genders, non-lesbian women, and men.
entries.raw_text: HALF MOON PINES c/o Barbara Hart, RD #1 Box 1446, Hamburg, PA 19526 (215)373-5697. Vacation cabin in the Blue Mountains. 3-4 bedrooms which accommodate 7 persons, huge, cozy kitchen and enclosed porch. The cabin is in a private setting in the State Game Lands, one mile down from the Appalachian Trail and a short distance from Blue Marsh Recreation Area and PA Dutch country. Rates $225/week, $150/weekend, $50/day. We welcome: new residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space because it is defined by offering vacation cabin rentals to visitors. Rural route mailing address copied to land address. Num_residents is left blank because 'We have/are: 2 lesbians' is not accompanied by 'women living on the land'. All six accepted groups coded: 'nonlesbian women' gives Non-lesbian women; 'girl & boy children' gives Girl children and Boy children; 'males' gives Gay men and Non-gay men; Lesbian women coded from directory context.

entries.description: A residential intentional community of 10 cottages with a cultural and spiritual center, feminist library, and health food store, where only lesbians may own or rent, welcoming girl children and non-lesbian women visitors.
entries.raw_text: PAGODA 207 Coastal Hwy, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a small lesbian residential community (10 separately owned cottages) with a cultural/spiritual center. Only lesbians can rent or own, but all wommin are welcome to become members and stay in one of our four bedrooms in the center as well as use our feminist library and health food store. Rules in our 2-story center: no smoking, no alcohol on main floor, no cooking or eating of meat, fish or fowl on main floor. We have a BBQ pit and flesh may be eaten elsewhere in building. No pets, no nudity on our property or directly in front of us on the beach. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women visitors. We have/are: 15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, ocean, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative because it is 'a small lesbian residential community (10 separately owned cottages)'. Street address is the land address. Num_residents is 15 based on '15 resident lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Focuses: Lesbian separatism coded for 'Only lesbians can rent or own'; Spirituality/ritual coded for 'cultural/spiritual center'; Archives/cultural work coded for 'feminist library'. 'no alcohol on main floor' is not coded as Recovery/substance-free because alcohol is not banned from the property. Accepted groups: Lesbian women from directory context, Non-lesbian women from 'nonlesbian women visitors', and Girl children from 'girl children'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: located in northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan; facing a sandy beach on Long Lake
entries.description: A women's wilderness resort on one acre with three cabins on Long Lake, run by two lesbians looking for women to invest and build an all-woman community, welcoming children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: LABRYS c/o Nell Wagenaar & Rebecca Clark, Rt 1 Box 257, Honor, MI 49640 (616)882-5994 (4115 M-22). Labrys is an inexpensive, synergetic wilderness resort for women located in northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan. We have three cabins nestled among tall White Pine and Oak facing a sandy beach on Long Lake with dock and boats. We are looking for women to invest in property here. Our dream is to make this end of Long Lake an all-woman community, with a possible campground, a quiet area for geese and heron nesting, more cabins and a community lodge for workshops, etc. Open year round. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children under 12, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 1 acre, 3 cabins, plumbing/electricity, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space because it is currently a 'wilderness resort for women', though aiming to expand into an intentional community. Rural route mailing address copied to land address (listing also notes physical road 4115 M-22). Num_residents is 2 from '2 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Boy children coded with condition 'under 12'. Non-lesbian women coded for 'nonlesbian women'. Future plans for workshops in a dream community lodge not coded as current Workshops/education focus.

entries.land_location_as_stated: Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL; by the Illinois River
entries.description: A secluded retreat on 14 acres by the Illinois River catering to women and lesbians, where a counselor proprietor hosts groups and retreats, welcoming new residents, children of all genders, non-lesbian women, and men.
entries.raw_text: RIVER SPIRIT RETREAT 187 W 19th St, Alton, IL 62002 (618)462-4051 or 653-4349 (retreat) or (314)773-3867 (St Louis). Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL, 1 hr from Alton, 2 hrs from St Louis. River Spirit Retreat is a scenic, secluded retreat for individuals and small groups by the Illinois River. Retreat caters to women, especially lesbians. Open to alternative humanitarian types, counselors or small businesses needing retreat atmosphere. Proprietor is counselor and offers groups and retreats several times a year. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 14 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, camping space, women living part-time and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space because it calls itself a retreat. Land location inferred from 'Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL'. Num_residents is 4, noted as living part-time ('women living part-time and working on the land'). All six accepted groups coded: 'girl & boy children' gives Girl children and Boy children; 'nonlesbian women' gives Non-lesbian women; 'males' gives Gay men and Non-gay men; Lesbian women coded from directory context. Workshops/education coded because proprietor 'offers groups and retreats several times a year'.
